logical_countermodel.premise_reading: Resolve the marked He as Mark, following the authentic positive companion label.
counterworld_facts: Mark tells Pete many lies about Mark; Pete includes those lies in Pete's book.
Mark should have been more truthful, so the official gold-resolved reading of the premise is true.

Pete also knowingly includes a separate fabricated story in the book and should have been more truthful. The original premise is silent about whether Pete has any independent reason to be more truthful.
logical_countermodel.why_consistent: The original passage does not state that only Mark should have been truthful or that Pete should not have been more truthful. Additional wrongdoing by Pete is compatible with every asserted source proposition and leaves the target He resolved to Mark.
logical_countermodel.logical_result: There exists a consistent world satisfying both the gold-resolved premise and the non-gold replacement hypothesis. Therefore the premise does not logically imply the negation of that hypothesis, and automatic contradiction is not licensed.
logical_countermodel.counterworld_only_not_entailment: This compatibility counterworld refutes necessity of contradiction. It does not establish entailment of the Pete-replaced hypothesis, nor an official neutral annotation. A separate world with Pete blameless is also compatible with the premise.
logical_countermodel.qualification: WSC relies on commonsense and pragmatic coreference judgments. The exercise respects its official gold referent and tests only the stronger universal contradiction conversion used in Q48.

decision_scope: One authentic item is sufficient to defeat a universal automatic conversion rule. It does not estimate how often the conversion fails across WSC and does not show performance or ranking consequences for any classifier.
